landing.featuresDesc: We are passionate Jesus followers dedicated to helping you shine with excellence and integrity in everything you do.
landing.featureExegesisDesc: Reach a deeper understanding of the Word. Discover original meanings through historical and literary context.
landing.featureKingdomDesc: Start each day with purpose-driven devotionals that reflect your mission and message in Christ.
landing.featurePrayerDesc: Build strong engagement and spread the Gospel through our dedicated community prayer platform.
landing.featureTriviaDesc: Engage with the Word right where you are. Be found searching for truth, hope, and deeper wisdom.
landing.featureGrowthDesc: We walk with you every step of the way, providing tools for your calling and Kingdom impact.
landing.featureAppDesc: Take the Word with you everywhere. Reach your community right where they are—on their phones.
landing.dailyDesc: Fresh devotional content every morning rooted in careful Scripture study.
landing.exegesisProjectDesc: We're going to want to make each section follow the features of the app
landing.prayerDesc: Lift each other up in faith. Submit a request or stand in the gap.
landing.testifyDesc: God is still writing amazing stories. Share your journey and help others see His power.
landing.triviaDesc: Grow in the Word through our interactive challenges. Hide His Word in your heart while having fun!
landing.wellDoneMsg: Well done! You're growing in wisdom.
landing.keepStudyingMsg: Keep studying! The Word is a lamp to your feet.
landing.aboutPara1: At Exegesis, we believe your spiritual journey deserves more than just a casual reading—it deserves a powerful, purpose-driven digital footprint rooted in faith and fueled by the Gospel.
landing.aboutPara2: We're not just another app—we're passionate Jesus followers, tech experts, and creative visionaries who live to serve the Lord in everything we do.
landing.aboutMotto: Quality, Service, & Integrity — Built for His Glory.
landing.aboutValueRootedDesc: Every insight and explanation is grounded in sound biblical scholarship and prayer.
landing.aboutValueGlobalDesc: Pray, testify, and grow alongside believers from every corner of the world.
landing.aboutValueSpiritDesc: We use modern technology to illuminate ancient wisdom for today's generation.
landing.aboutValueGrowingDesc: Constant updates and fresh content to keep your spiritual journey vibrant and active.
landing.ctaDesc: Join thousands of believers who are searching the Scriptures and living out their calling with excellence.
landing.footerDesc: Helping you shine with excellence and integrity through the power of the Word.
landing.prayerCard1Request: Please pray for my mother's healing. She was admitted to hospital yesterday and we trust God for a miracle.
landing.prayerCard2Request: Seeking God's direction for a new job. I have an interview next week and I need wisdom and favour.
landing.prayerCard3Request: Thank you all for praying for my marriage. God has restored what I thought was lost. He is faithful!
landing.testyCard1Story: When my company was on the verge of collapse, I turned to this app and found Joshua 1:9 in Exegesis Daily. Three weeks later, a contract appeared out of nowhere. God is real.
landing.testyCard2Story: For two years I battled hopelessness. The Prayer Wall community prayed with me. Psalm 34:18 became my anchor. I am standing today as living proof of God's love.
landing.testyCard3Story: I started sharing Exegesis Daily devotionals with my wife every morning. Within six months, my entire household gave their lives to Christ.
landing.triviaQ1: How many books are in the Old Testament?
landing.triviaQ3: Which book comes first in the New Testament?
landing.featureBibleAppDesc: Access the full Scriptures anytime, anywhere. Multiple translations for deeper study and understanding.
landing.featureBibleStudiesDesc: Structured study guides that walk you through books of the Bible with rich insights and historical context.
landing.featureVVTeachingDesc: Detailed verse-by-verse explanations to uncover the depth and meaning of every passage of Scripture.
landing.featureVDevotionalsDesc: Daily devotionals centered on specific verses to help you meditate on God's Word and apply it to your life.
landing.featureJournalingDesc: Capture your thoughts, prayers, and reflections as you journey through Scripture with guided journal prompts.
landing.featureChallengesDesc: Engage in Bible reading challenges and trivia to grow your knowledge and stay consistent in the Word.
landing.exegesisVVTeachingDesc: Explanation and application with a learn more tab just like our Lordsbook dailies verse by verse.

himFirstMedia.whoWeAreTagline: We're passionate Jesus followers, tech experts, and creative visionaries who live to serve the Lord in everything we do.
himFirstMedia.whoWeArePara1: At Exegesis, we believe your spiritual journey deserves more than just a casual reading — it deserves a powerful, purpose-driven digital footprint rooted in faith and fueled by the Gospel.
himFirstMedia.whoWeArePara2: We are a project of Him First Media Group, a full-service Christian digital marketing agency dedicated to helping Christian businesses, churches, and ministries shine online with excellence and integrity.
himFirstMedia.whoWeArePara3: Our goal is simple: to help you reach more people, impact more lives, and glorify God through the power of His Word.
himFirstMedia.whoWeAreValue1Desc: Every insight is grounded in sound biblical scholarship and prayer.
himFirstMedia.whoWeAreValue2Desc: Everything we do is centered around faith, excellence, and Kingdom impact.
himFirstMedia.whoWeAreValue3Desc: We use modern technology to illuminate ancient wisdom for today's generation.
himFirstMedia.whoWeAreMotto: "Quality, Service, & Integrity — Built for His Glory."
himFirstMedia.ourVisionTagline: To see every believer equipped with the Word of God through technology that inspires, teaches, and transforms.
himFirstMedia.ourVisionPara1: Our vision is to build the most comprehensive, accessible, and Spirit-led Bible study platform in the world. We envision a global community where believers from every nation can dive deep into Scripture, grow in their faith, and connect with others on the same journey.
himFirstMedia.ourVisionPara2: As a project of Him First Media Group, we are committed to using cutting-edge digital tools to spread the Gospel and make disciples of all nations. We believe that technology, when submitted to the Lordship of Jesus Christ, can be a powerful vehicle for Kingdom impact.
himFirstMedia.ourVisionPara3: We see a world where every Christian has a personalized Bible study experience — with daily verses, reading plans, journaling tools, and rich verse-by-verse teaching — all designed to draw them closer to the heart of God.
himFirstMedia.ourVisionVerse: "Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it."
himFirstMedia.ourMissionTagline: To help you reach more people, impact more lives, and glorify God through the power of His Word.
himFirstMedia.ourMissionPara1: Our mission is simple: to make the deep truths of Scripture accessible to everyone, everywhere. We believe that the Word of God is alive, active, and relevant for every generation — and we're committed to using every tool at our disposal to help people engage with it.
himFirstMedia.ourMissionPara2: As a project of Him First Media Group, we bring decades of experience in Christian digital marketing, app development, and web design to the service of the Church. We're not just building an app — we're building a movement of believers who are rooted in the Word and equipped for every good work.
himFirstMedia.ourMissionCard1Desc: Provide rich, verse-by-verse teaching that makes Scripture come alive.
himFirstMedia.ourMissionCard2Desc: Create a space where believers can pray, testify, and grow together.
himFirstMedia.ourMissionCard3Desc: Make the Bible accessible in multiple languages and translations.
himFirstMedia.ourMissionCard4Desc: Give believers the tools they need to study, journal, and apply God's Word.
himFirstMedia.ourGoalsTagline: Clear targets we're pursuing to fulfill our calling and maximize Kingdom impact.
himFirstMedia.ourGoalsCard1Desc: Help users read, understand, and apply the Bible daily through multi-translation access, verse-by-verse teaching, and interactive reading plans.
himFirstMedia.ourGoalsCard2Desc: Connect believers from every nation to pray for one another, share testimonies, and encourage each other in faith.
himFirstMedia.ourGoalsCard3Desc: Make the platform accessible in 23+ languages so that the Word of God can reach every tongue and tribe.
himFirstMedia.ourGoalsCard4Desc: Provide tools like journaling, reading challenges, and trivia that help young believers grow in their knowledge of Scripture.
himFirstMedia.ourGoalsCta: Join Us in Reaching These Goals
himFirstMedia.leadershipTagline: A team of dedicated professionals committed to serving the Lord with excellence.
himFirstMedia.leadershipPara1: Tom Donovan is the innovative Founder of Him First Media Group and a bold Christian businessman with a heart on fire for Jesus. With decades of entrepreneurial experience, Tom has launched and developed numerous faith-based companies and Christian digital products designed to serve the Body of Christ.
himFirstMedia.leadershipPara2: His mission is clear: to help ministries, churches, and Christian businesses grow, thrive, and impact the world for God's glory. Tom leads with integrity, creativity, and a deep love for the Lord, keeping his faith at the very top of everything he does.
himFirstMedia.leadershipPara3: Through his visionary leadership, countless organizations have built strong digital foundations rooted in faith, purpose, and excellence. Tom is not just building businesses — he's building the Kingdom.
himFirstMedia.leadershipClosing: "And He Himself gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers, for the equipping of the saints for the work of ministry."
himFirstMedia.foundersTagline: Built on a foundation of faith, vision, and a relentless commitment to Kingdom impact.
himFirstMedia.foundersSectionTitle: Tom Donovan — Founder, Him First Media Group
himFirstMedia.foundersPara1: The Exegesis Project was born out of the vision and resources of Him First Media Group, founded by Tom Donovan. A Christian businessman with a passion for using technology to advance the Gospel, Tom has spent decades building digital solutions that serve the Body of Christ.
himFirstMedia.foundersPara2: Him First Media Group is a full-service Christian digital marketing agency that specializes in Christian SEO, social media marketing, website design, and app development for Christian businesses, churches, and ministries. The company was founded on the principle that every digital effort should put Jesus first.
himFirstMedia.foundersPara3: The Exegesis Project is the fulfillment of a long-held dream to create a Bible study platform that combines deep theological insight with cutting-edge technology — making the Word of God accessible, engaging, and transformative for believers around the world.
himFirstMedia.foundersMotto: "Quality, Service, & Integrity — Built for His Glory."
himFirstMedia.foundersMottoRef: — The Him First Media Group Motto
himFirstMedia.foundersQuote: "The Exegesis Project was born out of a simple but powerful conviction that every believer deserves access to deep, reliable, and Spirit-led Bible study tools."
